Members

runSnyk

Runs the real Snyk CLI; returns parsed JSON or null on any failure.

normalizeYarnAudit

yarn audit --json emits NDJSON — one JSON object per line: auditAdvisory records (resolution path + advisory payload) and a closing auditSummary. Parse line-by-line and map each advisory to the report's vuln shape.
